bundle.longDescription: Kurasis Launcher is an independent launcher for Minecraft: Java Edition. It signs in with a Microsoft account, installs vanilla releases and a private Java runtime, and starts the game. Not an official Minecraft product; not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
